name: Pantheon
description: Reads master data, lots, recipes, work orders and stock out of Datalab Pantheon over the PAWS REST API and feeds them into OpenMES through the canonical ERP contract; pushes posted warehouse documents back as Pantheon Move documents. All Pantheon-specific knowledge (view names, acClassif codes, document types, column mapping) lives here — core stays ERP-agnostic.
author: OpenMES Team
